wish_star.name: Wish Star
wish_star.lore: Faintly warm. The Wish Fountain in the Petal Court wants it.

promise_key.name: Promise Key
promise_key.lore: Opens the moonlit door to the Moonlit Promise Sanctum.

waves.say: The petals close. Little lights circle in the dark.
The moon climbs and the lights grow sharp.

onDone.text: The moon sets. A Wish Star rests in the petals.
The story ends well. A ribbon gate unties itself, and a hidden page turns in the south-west wall.

mechanics.doneText: The story is told in order.
mechanics.failText: The story muddles. Read the ribbon strip on the south wall: lime, pink, light blue, yellow.

onDone.text: The petals open to the stars. A starlit alcove appears in the north wall.

onOpen.text: You make a wish. Petals drift aside from a gate in the south wall.

mechanics.hint: A glass dish at the fountain, waiting for a star.
mechanics.verb: drops the Wish Star in the dish and a gate of petals drifts aside.

onOpen.text: The moonlit door to the Sanctum opens.

mechanics.hint: A moonlit door with a keyhole shaped like a crescent.
mechanics.verb: turns the Promise Key and the moonlit door swings open.

encounters.say: Pages rustle by themselves. The stories in here have teeth.
Petals fall though there is no wind. Levers wait in the north; a glass dish waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Promise-Keeper
bosses.intro: The Promise-Keeper rises, smiling. Snuff the three moonstones on the trees to break its promise.
bosses.deathText: The Promise-Keeper curtsies, and the sanctum fills with petals.

shield.breakText: The moonstones go dark! The Promise-Keeper is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Promise-Keeper calls its servants.

effects.text: A hundred small lights open their eyes.

completion.intro: The Moonlit Promise. Tell the story in order, cross the ribbon, and make a wish at the fountain.
completion.message: The petals settle. The grove closes shortly.
